mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting central bank policy easing and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates rate cuts.
failure_condition: UNRATE above 5.0 fails to predict positive returns when 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS above 143000) combined with rising housing starts (HOUST above 1170) indicates robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in sustained growth.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails when the joint condition is met but 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 > 16000), rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 238.5) signals overheating, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in rate hikes.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails when the joint condition is met but 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1100 units signals weak consumer demand and potential economic slowdown, prompting central bank policy easing and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates rate cuts.
failure_condition: HOUST below 1100 fails to predict positive returns when 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105 (2017=100) signals weakening economic activity, prompting central bank policy easing and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: INDPRO below 105 fails to predict positive returns when 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential sales (RSAFS above 440000) indicates strong housing market activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors price in continued economic growth.
failure_condition: RSAFS above 440000 fails to predict positive returns when 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL < 235), rising interest rates compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in higher discount rates.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails when the joint condition is met but 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).
